note: THE COMMITTED e2e SUITE SET. scripts/assert-e2e-proof-fresh.mjs walks this
checkout for <Category>/<Tool>/test/e2e/package.json and requires the result
to EQUAL `suites` exactly, in both directions.
WHY IT IS A FILE AND NOT A CONSTANT IN THE GATE: a derived set cannot tell
'this tool never had a suite' from 'this tool's suite was deleted in this
commit'. The committed side supplies that. Held as a constant in the gate the
check had to be inert wherever the tool directory was absent, so `rm -rf
<Category>/<Tool>` was silent — MEASURED 2026-08-27 on a two-suite bite tree,
with the run history losing the same leg: `legs=1/1  GREEN`, exit 0. Held
here it is a fact about the tree being graded, so the same deletion reddens.
DELETING A SUITE MEANS DELETING ITS LINE HERE IN THE SAME COMMIT. That is the
point: the shrink becomes a line in the diff instead of a deletion nobody
reads. ADDING one means adding its line here in the same commit — an unlisted
suite is a red that names it, so a new suite is protected from the first day
This key is ignored by the gate; `suites` is the whole subject.
